steps: Create Catalyst Cache segments in the Catalyst console and copy each Segment ID into backend/app-config.json env_variables.
Create Data Store tables and columns from iac/datastore.schema.json. Use table IDs only when table names become ambiguous.
Import seed CSV files only after tables exist. Catalyst CLI ds:import handles row import, not schema creation.
Deploy AppSail and API Gateway to Catalyst development using catalyst deploy --only appsail,apig.
Deploy the client after Vite build output is present in client/dist.
Promote to production from the Catalyst console after development smoke tests pass.
rollback: Revert AppSail deployment from Catalyst console deployment history.
Re-deploy the previous catalyst-user-rules.json for API Gateway rollback.
Keep R2 object versions or immutable manifest keys so launcher manifests can point back to the last known-good object keys.
Use Data Store export before schema-affecting migrations; restore rows through ds:import if rollback is needed.
